Class Properties

java.lang.Object
msfx.lib.util.Properties
public class Properties extends Object
A useful and quite generic properties table with typed access for commonly used objects.

A filter for accepted keys and values classes can be set to configure the type of data that can be put into these properties.

Author:
Miquel Sas

    • clear

      public void clear()

    • copy

      public Properties copy()
      Returns:
      A deep copy of this properties object. Values out of Maps.VALUE_CLASSES are not copied: the copy refers to the same objects.

    • put

      public void put(Object key, Object value)
      Parameters:
      key - The key.
      value - The value to associate with the key.

    • putObject

      public void putObject(Object key, Object value)
      Puts a value of any class, including classes out of Maps.VALUE_CLASSES. Read it back with getObject(Object, Class).

      A value out of Maps.VALUE_CLASSES is not copied by copy(): the copy refers to the same object.

      Parameters:
      key - The key.
      value - The value to associate with the key.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - If the value is null.

      Returns:

      public Set<Object> keys()
